newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.

LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Some concern that recent run-up in beef prices may have run out of steam. Cash market seen quiet Monday with opinions fairly evenly divided about whether trade will develop this week at a steady $66 per cwt or possibly $1 higher at $67.
FEEDER CATTLE - 0.100 to 0.250 cent lower. Overnight gains in CBOT corn futures may weigh on the market early.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Cash hogs seen steady to $0.50 higher Monday. Rising product prices also supportive.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to 0.500 cent. Cash fresh pork belly market remains firm, aided by recent light kills.
